registers.description: Current state of the main controller FSM (IDLE, LOAD, COMPUTE, OUTPUT, ERROR).
Operating mode/configuration latch, updated externally via mode_wr_en.
Interrupt-pending flag, set when the FIFO would overflow during OUTPUT and cleared on irq_ack.
Write-side address pointer into the output FIFO memory.
Read-side address pointer into the output FIFO memory.
Running multiply-accumulate sum produced during the COMPUTE state.
First pipeline staging register for an incoming data operand, loaded during LOAD state.
Second pipeline staging register for an incoming data operand, loaded directly from data_in during LOAD state.
